Searching for MemoService's two protocols and their registration files.

The two protocols are gRPC-Gateway/REST and ConnectRPC. Now locating their registration files.
I'll find how MemoService is registered for each of the two protocols.

Two protocols were identified. I am checking v1.go to find their registration paths. I am also verifying whether Connect is handled in a separate file. MCP was considered but ruled out since the question asks for two protocols.

The two protocols are gRPC-Gateway and ConnectRPC. I am now examining v1.go to locate their exact registration paths.
Looking for the Connect protocol registration. The wrapping logic is in connect_services.go, but the registration itself may be defined elsewhere.

The two protocols are gRPC-Gateway and ConnectRPC.

gRPC-Gateway is registered in server/router/api/v1/v1.go via RegisterMemoServiceHandlerServer.

ConnectRPC is wrapped in connect_services.go and registered in connect_handler.go.

A comment claims native gRPC support, yet the code shows no grpc.NewServer or RegisterMemoServiceServer. The actual two protocols are being identified.

MemoService is served over gRPC-Gateway REST and Connect. The gRPC-Gateway registration is in server/router/api/v1/v1.go. Connect wrapping is in connect_services.go and registration is in server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go.

Both Connect files will be listed under the Connect line.

q19.
gRPC-Gateway — server/router/api/v1/v1.go
Connect — server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go

`RegisterGateway` in `server/router/api/v1/v1.go` mounts REST via `v1pb.RegisterMemoServiceHandlerServer`. Connect registration is `RegisterConnectHandlers` / `apiv1connect.NewMemoServiceHandler` in `server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go`; the request wrappers live in `server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go`.
